extDescription.message: WhatsApp in the side panel: below a chosen width it shows one pane at a time, the chat list or the open chat, with a back button.

optShowNav.message: Icon bar next to the chat list

noPage.message: No WhatsApp page detected. Open or reload the panel.

hiddenOnly.message: Warning: the chat did not really close. It stays open behind the list and new messages may be marked as read.

diagNoAnswer.message: WhatsApp is not answering: open the panel and try again.

diagCopied.message: Copied: it contains only the page structure, no text.

diagCopyFailed.message: Could not copy to the clipboard.
